rationale: Main contribution is a general AI-reliability-engineering framework (FMEA, TEVV, NIST AI RMF); its worked cases are a CNN and an autonomous vehicle, not LLM agents, and agentic conduct is only one of four failure categories.
Introduces and evaluates runtime coordination among LLM-driven multi-agent AI-scientist systems (Agent Laboratory, EvoScientist, ARK).
Benchmarks multi-agent coordination strategies among LLM-based specialist agents for graph learning.
Builds and trains a tool-use agent (CASE) with agentic RL for autonomous evidence-seeking, even though the application domain is clinical imaging.
Benchmarks LLM coding agents on end-to-end repository generation and analyses agent trajectories.
Classical multi-agent reinforcement learning (Dec-POMDP) for hospital patient flow; no LLM agent is involved.
Benchmark for safety/misalignment risk arising specifically from self-evolving LLM agents.
Multi-agent LLM framework with tool use and planning for chemistry problem solving; the agent methodology, not the chemistry, is the stated contribution.
Taxonomy/survey of LLM agents equipped with workflow harnesses for data-science tasks.
Benchmarks the planning lifecycle of tool-calling LLM agents.
Benchmark suite specifically for agentic LLM inference performance, explicitly framed as an agent benchmark.
Benchmark for LLM agents' autonomous evidence retrieval and reasoning, applied to power-system data.
Resource-authorization defense for autonomous coding agents; an agent-safety contribution.
Benchmark for LLM agents performing agentic programming and exploration in a game engine.
Multi-agent LLM system (Proposer/Actor) built and optimized end-to-end for generating faithful explanations.
Proposes an evaluation methodology treating LLM agents as configurable systems and studies agent configuration choices directly.
Compares LLM-based multi-agent architectures (orchestrator/peer-to-peer/monolithic) coordinating smart-manufacturing control.
Introduces a compositional policy for adaptive, token-efficient agentic inference in LLM agents.
Primarily a video-temporal-grounding accuracy technique; the agentic framing improves a VLM's tool orchestration but the measured contribution is video QA accuracy, not agent behavior.
Benchmark for the security of multi-agent LLM debate under adversarial attacks.
Addresses planner-actor coordination failures in long-horizon LLM agentic tasks.
Benchmark for voice interfaces conveying instructions to LLM-based computer-use agents.
Self-evolving orchestration framework for LLM-based multi-agent tool-using systems.
Self-evolving multi-agent LLM system (dynamic router, Mixture-of-Agents) for subtitle translation; the agent architecture is the stated contribution.
Benchmark suite for agentic-AI task success, latency and cost on personal devices.
Agentic framework for detecting malicious Agent Skills using compact LLMs; agent-security focus.
First refreshable anomaly-detection benchmark specifically for LLM-based multi-agent systems.
Formalizes and benchmarks multi-robot Vision-and-Language Navigation coordinated by an explicit LLM-based subtask scheduler (TRISS), though the task itself is robotic navigation.
Primary contribution is a benchmark for automated theorem-proving/proof discovery in theoretical CS; an agent-workflow comparison is a secondary analysis axis, not the main object of study.
Communication-theory tutorial for multi-agent embodied systems; no LLM is involved.
Runtime defense protecting LLM-based Web agents from deceptive-interface manipulation; agent-safety focus.
Directly studies and mitigates tool-schema bias in the behavior of LLM agents.
Autonomous framework in which agents distill and reuse skills from execution trajectories to improve visual reasoning; agent self-improvement is the stated contribution.
Multi-agent LLM system that decouples molecular-design reasoning from search-state management via specialized agents.
Dual-system LLM agent architecture (fast voice interaction + deliberative tool-using agent) for full-duplex voice assistants.
Studies oversight of tool-equipped AI agents via small-language-model relevance classifiers over MCP tool calls.
Evolving benchmark for runtime security risks of LLM-plus-harness workspace agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw).
Primarily an e-commerce cross-video reasoning benchmark; the agentic tool-selection method is a technique to raise video-QA accuracy, not the object of study.
LLM-based prompting framework for gene-set annotation; no agent, tool-use, or multi-agent component.
Directly studies and improves LLM agents' ability to detect and recover from mid-task failures.
Bayesian-routing system between two LLM sizes for CV screening; no tool use, planning, or multi-agent coordination.
Evaluates robustness of tool-using LLM agents (plus a RAG baseline) to variation in how requests are phrased.
Offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework; no LLM is involved.
Primarily a VLM-based wildfire-monitoring and reporting tool; the multi-agent memory system is in service of report accuracy, not agent-behavior research.
Agentic platform in which LLM-based agents compose typed tools and encode recurring hardware-software co-design workflows.
Benchmark for translating natural-language intent into executable tool invocations (CLI commands), fitting the tool-use/function-calling criterion.
Primary contribution is an information-retrieval benchmark for paper-inspiration discovery; agentic search is one of several retrieval baselines compared, not the object of study.
Studies reducing LLM-agent call/token overhead for a VLM-driven robot agent's action planning.
Couples an evolutionary heuristic-design loop with an explicit two-agent (Reasoner/Coder) LLM workflow.
Demonstrates a covert-exfiltration attack that specifically abuses an LLM agent's web-fetching tool capability; agent/tool-use security.
Grounds an LLM-based agent's natural-language planning in a hierarchical task-and-motion-planning framework for spacecraft operations.
Introduces a controlled framework for auditing communication behavior specifically within LLM multi-agent systems.
Legal research assistant whose core contribution is a multi-agent workflow decomposing and synthesizing complex legal research tasks.
Introduces a label-free cost framework for optimizing multi-agent LLM workflow construction and execution, with an explicit multi-agent-coordination benchmark.
Studies how supervised fine-tuning on agent trajectories trades off new tool-using capability against retained capability.
Empirical study of practitioner-reported issues, causes and fixes specifically in open-source LLM-based multi-agent systems.
Agent-harness design for auditable coding-agent-driven formal proof development and verification.
Benchmark explicitly evaluating VLM agents' task-planning and manipulation capability as robot generalists.
Meta multi-agent reinforcement learning (Markov games) for autonomous driving; no LLM agent is involved.
Benchmark for AI coding agents performing long-horizon agentic reasoning on production incident response.
Multi-agent collaborative time-series forecasting framework; no LLM is mentioned, reading as a general multi-agent ML system for a forecasting application.
Studies spatial reasoning and tool discovery/use by an LLM serving as a high-level agent orchestrator.
Controlled comparison of LLM-planner/LLM-executor autonomous red-team agents against RL-based agents across cyber environments.
Self-evolving robot-agent harness coupling semantic (language) reasoning with physical execution and capability revision.
Standardized benchmark specifically for the speed/efficiency of LLM-driven computer-use agents.
Classical Multi-Agent Path Finding under map uncertainty using Gaussian belief propagation; no LLM is involved.
Benchmark and harness for VLM-based computer-use agents operating professional scientific software.
Classical Multi-Agent Path Finding post-optimization via exact decomposition/ILP; no LLM is involved.
Tool-call authorization defense specifically for LLM-based agents against skill-injection attacks; agent-safety focus.
Primary contribution is specializing an LLM for algorithmic-trading code generation via pretraining/SFT; agentic evaluation is a secondary measurement, not the object of study.
Benchmark for VLM perception of human tool use in egocentric video; not about LLM-agent tool use.
Reputation-based aggregation system defending LLM-powered multi-agent debate against malicious agents.
Capability-grounded benchmark specifically for skill-evolution harnesses in autonomous coding agents.
Self-evolving agent system connecting a general-purpose coding agent to robot sensing/execution/persistent experience.
DAG-based multi-agent framework (Orchestrator/Executor roles) for deep-research planning, with an explicit agent-architecture training signal.
Classical model-based trajectory-planning framework for off-road vehicles; no LLM agent is involved.
New agent-learning paradigm (retrospective world modeling) studied directly on VLM agents' policy-learning behavior.
Agentic tool-augmented multi-turn reasoning framework integrating 22 specialized forensic tools for image-forgery detection; the tool-use agent architecture is the stated contribution.
Studies explicit behavioral trajectory diversity in RL-based post-training specifically for LLM agents.
LLM-based graph agents trained via GRPO to explore and reason over knowledge graphs through tool interactions.
Tool-using scientific-reasoning agent system with a controller and read-only evidence tools; the agent architecture is the stated contribution.
Develops a multi-step retrieval tool specifically to remove a bottleneck in LLM agents' visual agentic search.
Decentralized architecture paper for scalable, fault-tolerant LLM-based multi-agent systems.
Controlled comparison of RAG retrieval-pipeline designs for scientific QA; an agentic tool-call pipeline is one of six compared baselines, not the object of study.
Introduces a formal framework for auditing loss-of-control incidents and safety evaluations specifically in autonomous agents.
Infrastructure for programmable collaboration and controllable runtime specifically in multi-agent coding systems.
Robot-manipulation harness connecting a general-purpose VLM directly to control; explicitly avoids coding agents/tool frameworks as unnecessary complexity.
Dataset/benchmark of passenger natural-language instructions evaluated against language-conditioned driving models; no agent tool-use, planning or coordination architecture.
LLM coding agents that search over and modify their own instructions/tools via recorded self-improvement experience.
Framework for developing and evaluating autonomous, adaptive social-interaction agents driven by LLMs.
LLM-based agent autonomously optimizing scientific software performance end to end.
Figure-centric multimodal QA benchmark for interpreting scientific literature; 'scientific agents' is aspirational framing for the broader AIVC vision, not the evaluated object.
Benchmark for autonomous agents operating professional engineering software end to end across the design loop.
Benchmark for LLM agents on enterprise-level interactive strategic reasoning and decision-making.
Data-generation framework synthesizing spatial VQA training data via multi-agent coding as an implementation detail; the object of study is MLLM spatial-reasoning training data, not agent behavior.
Attack on LLM-powered multi-agent recommender systems exploiting their collaborative-reflection mechanism; agent-security focus.
Training-free context-compression framework evaluated across agentic benchmarks (tool-calling, web, multi-turn dialogue) for LLM agents.
Topology-concealment defense specifically for LLM-based multi-agent system communication structure.
Recommendation agents that autonomously perceive, reason over and act on user preferences, with a memory mechanism for long-context agent reasoning.
Benchmark for multimodal GUI agents operating professional materials-science software.
